environment.note: load generator and server share the same machine

latency.workload: 1 sender + 1 receiver; 1,000 single-character insert batches sent one at a time (next sent after ack + 5 ms); 100 warm-up ops excluded

throughput.workload: 10 clients in one room; 2 writers send 10-character insert batches at random positions with up to 8 unacked batches each, for 10 s; 8 passive receivers

recovery.workload: 20 outages (+1 warm-up): connection cut via TCP proxy, 13 characters typed offline, network restored and an immediate retry triggered; timed until connected and every edit acknowledged. Excludes backoff wait (backoff schedule: 0.5 s × 2^n with equal jitter, capped at 30 s).
